marks.gloss_en: R' Yochanan: one of the brothers who died -- all the brothers should worry; one of a fellowship who died -- the whole fellowship should worry
one who traps a bird into a migdal is liable

מתניתין רבי יהודה, ברייתא רבי שמעון -- the two sources follow two tannaim (= p_matnitin_r_yehuda, p_baraita_r_shimon)
the mishna [all destructive acts exempt] is R' Yehuda
ורבי יהודה? התם מתקן הוא -- circumcision is constructive, כדרב אשי (= p_hatam_metaken)
התם מתקן הוא -- cooking the wick is constructive, כדרב אשי (= p_hatam_metaken)
כדרב אשי -- repairing a circumcision is like repairing a vessel
כדרב אשי -- cooking a wick is like cooking dyes
and R' Yehuda? there [circumcision, the priest's daughter] it is constructive
since the Torah forbade kindling in the case of the priest's daughter, conclude that a kindler in general is liable
